title: Debugging Offline CloudDash Agents
content: When a CloudDash agent reports as 'Offline' in the dashboard, it means the agent daemon has stopped sending heartbeats. Step 1: Log in to the host machine. Step 2: Run 'sudo systemctl status clouddash-agent' to check if the daemon is running. Step 3: If stopped, restart it using 'sudo systemctl restart clouddash-agent'. Step 4: Check agent logs at '/var/log/clouddash-agent/agent.log' for connection errors. Common causes include outgoing port 443 blockages on firewall or an invalid API key in '/etc/clouddash-agent/config.yaml'. Verify your API key in the CloudDash settings. If the daemon fails to start, verify that the configuration file is well-formed YAML and contains no syntax errors.
